verdict.rationale: The docs confirm an official Gemini mobile app: Android users can say "Hey Google" to get help with what's on screen, and the help page refers to "Gemini mobile app features." The same page notes that some mobile features are unavailable for work or school accounts, which matters for a knowledge-worker. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an iOS app, documentation of mobile feature parity (Live, Deep Research, Connected Apps, file uploads on mobile), and independent hands-on reports of the mobile apps.
